[https://blogs.perl.org/users/aristotle/2022/12/goodbye-prepan.html|PrePAN is no more]. It [https://web.archive.org/web/20210617225957/http://prepan.org/|used to be] a place where module authors could ask about module issues (like naming) before releasing the modules to CPAN.
